tei:titleStmt.tei:title: 85)༄༅/bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i char rgyun bzhugs so/86)na mo gu ru sa manta bha dra pradzñā ye/kun bzang 'chi med lha lam nas/shes
85)༄༅/bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i char rgyun bzhugs so/86)na mo gu ru sa manta bha dra pradzñā ye/kun bzang 'chi med lha lam nas/shes

tei:div.tei:p: 85) ༄༅/ bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i char rgyun bzhugs so/ 86)

na mo gu ru sa manta bha dra pradzñā ye/ kun bzang 'chi med lha lam nas/ shes rab snang mdzad bdag po yis// 'gro khams ma rig mun bcil ba// rig 'dzin gang skyabs kyi mchog /gang khyod dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho yi// bdag po klu dbang mchog shes nas// thugs rje nor bu'i sprin chen las// byin rlabs char chen dbab phyir bri/ ji ltar 'byor pa'i yo byad tshogs par byas nas/ thog mar skyabs sems ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa skyobs mdzad pa// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// nges pa'i don du sems bskyed nas/ 'gro la phan phyir bla ma bsgom/ lan gsum/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ sogs/ lan gsum/ sngon gtor gtong ba ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis gnyug ma'i he ru ka'i skur gyur/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ pheṃ pheṃ/ a ka ro= sogs/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang glu// gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la// gsang spyod don du sa phyogs 'di// bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol/ 87) gtor ma gnyis pa/ sarba bhighnan na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo= sogs/ hūm̐/ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*// yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang*// mkha' 'gro rnams kyi mthu rtsal gyis// log par 'dren pa bdud kyi tshogs// 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs// sumbha ni= sogs/ hūm̐/ nga ni ye nas ngang gi khro// mtshams gcod khro bos nam mkha' gang*// bgegs 'dul khro mo'i rol mtshams nas// su yang 'da' bar ma byed cig oṃ hrīḥbadzra kro dha rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭaḥ mchod rdzas rlob pa ni/ bdag gi thugs las ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros pas// mchod rdzas dngos 'dzin nyes skyon bsreg gtor sbyang*// rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa'i sgyu 'phrul las// rang byung phyi nang mchod pa'i phung po ni// zag med 'dod yon cir yang 'char ba yi// kun bzang mchod sprin nam mkha'i khams gang gyur//

oṃ ma hā pū dza sarba sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ dngos gzhi ni/ 88) 'khor 'das chos kun mi dmigs spros bral ngang*// 'gag med snying rje'i rang mdangs zung 'jug las// rang nyid skad cig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar gsal gri thod 'dzin// zhabs gnyis dor stabs spyan gsum nam mkhar gzigs// rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar gdod ma nas// 'khor 'das rang dag lhun grub rgyal ba'i zhing*// ye shes 'od lnga'i zer mdangs 'khrugs pa'i klong*// seng khri padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du// skyabs kun 'dus gzugs gcig chog chos kyi rje// rig 'dzin chen po kun bzang shes rab ni// dkar dmar mdangs ldan chos gos gsum gyis klubs// dbu la 'dab ldan padma'i mnyen zhu gsol// phyag gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can// zhal rgyan gnag snum thugs ka'i rgya mdor sleb// zhabs gnyis g.yo med rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// dbu gtsug 'ja' thig 'od khyim grangs med par// kun bzang rdor sems dga' rab shrī seng*// 'jam dpal 89) dzñā na su tra bī ma la// o rgyan yab yum rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga// so zur gnubs dang nyang gur rgod kyi ldem// kun mkhyen klong chen rong zom chos kyi bzang*// ratna gling pa paṇa chen padma dbang*// shes rab 'od zer mi 'gyur rdo rje 'chang*// gter bdag gling pa karma chags med zhabs// rigs brgya'i khyab bdag 'jigs med gling pa sogs// bka' gter rig 'dzin bla ma sprin ltar 'khrigs// gtso bo'i mtha' bskor 'ja' zer thig le'i klong*// bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' rgyud shangs pa dang*// sbyor drug zhi gcod bsnyen sgrub la sogs pa'i// brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang*// yi dam zhi khro sangs rgyas byang chub sems// mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho sprin phung 'khrigs// gang 'dul mos ngor rab 'byams zhi khro yi// dkyil 'khor rnam rol cir yang 'char bar gyur// de ltar gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po// mgrin par āḥdamar thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po// rgyal kun rdo rje

90)gsum gyi ngo bor gyur// thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis// phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i de bzhin gshegs pa kun// chos sku 'gyur med ngang las gzugs sku'i sprin// rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnam par spyan drangs gyur/ spyan 'dren pa ni/ oṃ/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas// skye med bla ma gshegs su gsol// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i pho brang nas// gsal dag bla ma gshegs su gsol// sprul pa sku yi pho brang nas// thugs rje can rnams gshegs su gsol// 'ja' dang 'od du kyi li li// sku dang thig ler shigs se shig 'khor du yi dam lha tshogs dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor// khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis// byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol// gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la// sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur// bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ oṃ badzra sa ma yā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ ye shes 91)dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams// mkha' la sprin ltar gshegs nas kyang*// mdun gyi tshogs zhing la thim pas// gnyis med dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs// tshogs bsog pa ni/ rang gi thugs las sprul pa yi// lha mo rnams dang sems can kun// bya byed thun mong par gyur nas// phyag mchod las la 'jug par gyur// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun ste// kun gyi byed po bla ma yin// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// mkha' ltar khyab pa'i rtsa gsum 'khor lo la// bdag dang mtha' yas 'gro ba ma lus pas/

lus 'di zhing rdul grangs rnyed rab sprul nas/ 92) /sgo gsum gus pas rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ mchod pa ni/ oṃ/ dpag med nam mkha'i khams nyid las// mchod yon bsam yas lhun grub pa// rab 'byams nam mkha'i khams bkang ste// gus pa'i blo yis dbul bar bgyi/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra titstsha ho/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ rnams dang*/ pādyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhu pai/ a lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dya/ shabta/ rnams bcug tshul khrims lte ba la brten pa'i// rnam 'byed shes rab rtsibs rno zhing*// ting 'dzin mu khyud kyis bskor ba'i// 'khor lo rin chen dbul bar bgyi /oṃ tsakra ratna badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bsod nams rgya mtsho las thon zhing*// blo yi mun stug rab bsal nas// dgos 'dod kun 'byung dad pa yi// nor bu rin chen dbul bar bgyi/ oṃ ma ṇi ratna badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ rang bzhin gnyug ma'i ye shes sku// gzhon nu gzugs sgra reg byas 'khyud// mi 'gyur bde chen skyed mdzad pa'i/ 93) /btsun mo rin chen dbul bar bgyi/ oṃ st+ri ratna badzra pū dzi te= bla ma mchog gsum rje bor gus// rnam dkar dge bcu'i chab srid skyong*// dran shes bag yod nor gyis phyug /blon po rin chen= oṃ pū ru ṣa ratna= mang thos padma'i mtsho la rol// bdag med rtogs pa'i lus stobs rgyas// mtshan 'dzin rtog pa 'joms byed pa'i// glang po rin chen= oṃ hasti ratna= dbang bzhi'i lus mdzes brtson 'grus kyi// grol lam mgyogs pa'i 'gros bzang pos// 'dod don myur du 'grub byed pa'i// rta mchog rin chen= oṃ a shwa= gang shar ngo la cer blta ba'i// shes rab rig pa'i mtshon rnon pos// rnam rtog dgra las rgyal byed pa'i// dmag dpon rin chen= oṃ kharga ratna= dga' bzhi bcu drug nyams rgyas pa'i// rdo rje'i rig ma bcu drug dang*// gsang ba phyag rgya bzhi'i sbyor ba// zag med bde ba bskyed phyir 'bul//

ma hā su kha pū dza ho/ gtsang dme'i 94)rtog bral bdud rtsi'i sman// nyon mongs chags med rakta'i rgyun// bza' bca' btung ba'i 'dod yon rdzas// 'khor gsum dmigs med nyid du 'bul/ a mṛ ta rakta ba lingta pu dza ho/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// dpag med zhing na gang mchis pa// de kun blo yis blangs te 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la byin gyis rlobs// sarba ma hā pū dza ho/ chos dbyings rang byung rol pa'i rtsal// phyi nang snod bcud snang srid chos/ khyab bdal zhing khams mchod sprin bcas// 'khor gsum yang dag nyid du 'bul/ sarba pū dza ratna maṇḍal hūm̐/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ ma bcos spros bral 'od gsal snying po'i ngang*// rnam mang rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs// sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i bla ma la// kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam du bstod par bgyi/ yan lag bcu pa ni/ bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che// yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs 95)su mchi// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod// sdig pa ma lus so sor bshags// dge ba kun la yi rang zhing*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol// rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'grub par shog lan gsum/ gsol 'debs ni/ oṃ/ skye 'chi med pa gsal la dwangs// rdo rje'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// lus la bde bar byin gyis rlobs// sku yi rdo rje bdag sgrub mdzod/ āḥ 'gag med gsung dbyangs chos kyi sgra// ā li kā lir gsol ba 'debs// ngag la nus par byin gyis rlobs// gsung gi rdo rjer bdag sgrub mdzod// hūm̐/ ka dag chen po kun bzang klong*// cir mi dgongs la gsol ba 'debs// zad sar 'khyol bar byin gyis rlobs// thugs kyi rdo rjer bdag sgrub mdzod// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa ni/

96) khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnyen gcig pu// 'gro ba skyabs med rnams kyi skyabs// thar pa'i them skas chen po ste// ma rig sel ba'i sgron me la// mun pa'i tshogs bdag skyabs su mchi// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// nyon mongs me yi gdung ba la// thugs rje'i char gyis bsil bar mdzod// bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che// bdag la re sa gzhan na med// deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// skyid sdug re ltos khyed mkhyen pas// mgon med bdag la thugs rjes gzigs/ nad gdon bgegs dang bar chad sol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ bzlas pa ni/ bla ma'i thugs las 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun// dkar gsal 'phros pas rang lus yongs su gang*// nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag /bde chen ye shes nyams rtogs ches cher g.yos// de yi ngang la khyad par sngags kyi sgra// bung ba tshang zhig ltar grags snang 97) srid kun// mer 'khyom 'ur 'ur rab tu g.yo bar gyur/ oṃ badzra ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐/ ci nus bzla/ dbang blang ba ni/ bla ma'i sku yi gnas gsum yi ge las// dkar dmar mthing ga'i 'od zer rim gcig char// byung bas rang gi spyi mgrin snying khar thim// lus ngag yid dang snang gsum sgrib pa sbyangs// dbang bzhi rim par thob nas sku gsung thugs// ye shes rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ tshogs mchod byed par spro na/ rang nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas// ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros me rlung chur gyur pas// dngos 'dzin nyes skyon thams cad bsregs gtor bkrus// rlung me thod pa'i sgyed pur a yig las// byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che'i nang*// sha lnga bdud rtsir sa bon bcu yis mtshan// rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas khol rlangs pa yis// 'khor 'das bdud rtsi'i dwangs mar zhu ba'i rgyun// 'dres pas zag med 'dod yon bdud rtsir gyur//

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ byin 98) gyis brlab/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyi mdun gyi mkhar// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung tshogs// sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin du spyan drangs nas// tshogs zhing rnams dang gnyis med bzhugs par gyur/ spyan drangs ni/ oṃ/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*// rang bzhin mtha' dbus med pa'i dkyil// ye shes bzhi 'phro 'khor lo'i tshul// tshogs mchog dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol/ oṃ badzra sa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam ho/ mchod pa ni/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg ldan pa'i// 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa ni// gus pa'i blo yis 'bul lags na// dgyes pa'i gar gyis bzhes su gsol/ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ bshags pa ni/ thog med dus nas da lta'i bar// sgo gsum mi shes bag med pas// nyams chag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa// de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /yig brgya brjod/ bsgral bstab ni/ nṛ tri badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ hūm̐/ nga ni za byed chen po ste/ khams gsum 99)ma lus bsgral ba dang*// gdul dka' ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir// sha rus la sogs bza' bar bya/ mā ra ya phaṭa: ma hā maṃ sa rakta kiṃ ni ri ti a mṛ ta khā hi: tshogs la rol ba ni/ ho/ tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyan du rol/ a la la hoḥ he ru ka dpal grong khyer du/ sogs/ smon lam gdab/ lhag ma ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lhag ma'i gtor ma 'dod yon gyi phung po zad mi shes par gyur/ pheṃḥ hūm̐/ mkha' 'gro ging dang dbang phyug ma// ma bdun sring bzhi 'bar ma brgyad// pho nya la sogs lhag sdud tshogs// dpal gyi pham phab 'di gsol la// bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod// oṃ uṣatshitsaṭa ba liṃ ta khā hiḥ chad tho ni/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe bskal pa'i dang po la// slob dpon padma thod phreng gis// dam la btags pa'i srung ma rnams// chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon// gdong dmar bod kyi rgyal khams su// lha srin sde brgyad dam la btags// bdag ni

100) slob dpon de yi brgyud/ khyod ni lha 'dre g.yar dam can// sngon tshe khas blangs bka' ma bcag /da lta rig 'dzin dam ma bral// rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhais la// bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ brtan ma ni/ bhyo/ slob dpon padma thod phreng gi /bka' nyan ma mo brtan ma'i tshogs// dam rdzas dpal gyi gtor ma longs// bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ rta bro ni/ hūm̐/ nga ni 'jigs byed chen po ste/ khams gsum thams cad spyi nas gnon// dgra bgegs gdug can 'byung po rnams// dug gsum las kyi khong bur mnan/ mnan no bcings so sa ma ya// rdo rje bro yis rgyas btab pas// sus kyang 'jig par nus ma yin/ oṃ lam/ āḥlam/ hūm̐ lam/ st+wam bha ya nan/ rjes chog ni/ badzra puṣpe= sogs/ bstod par 'os pa= sogs/ ma rnyed yongs su= sogs/ yig brgya/ 'dir ni rten dang= sogs/ su pra= sogs/ bdag gi sgo gsum gyis mtshon snang srid kun// bla ma'i sku 101) gsung thugs kyi klong du 'dus// de nyid chos sku skye med dbyings thim pas// dmigs med bsam brjod bral ba'i ngang la gnas// de las snang stong sgyu ma'i skur ldang nas// cir snang bla ma'i rol par sad par gyur// 'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba rnams// rang don zhi bde'i dri mas ma gos par// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams ma lus pa// bla med byang chub thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo// rgyal ba kun dngos rje btsun bla ma yis// dus gsum kun tu brtse bas rjes bzung ste// 'gro kun sgrol zhing gsang chen rdo rje'i lam// dka' ba med par myur du bgrod par shog

shis brjod ni/ oṃ/ byin rlabs mchog stsol rigs brgya'i bdag /bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dngos grub char 'bebs zhi dang khro// yi dam lha tshogs bkra shis shog /thog med phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i= gang la bsam pa de yi 'grub// dge legs mchog gi bkra shis shog tshul 'di dad pa'i 102) sprin gzhon gyis/ dge tshogs gru char dbab pa yis// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i zhings 'dul// phan bde'i 'bras bzang smin byed shog zhes pa'ang btsun pa chos kyi grags pa'i bzhed skong du rig pa 'dzin pa dpal chen 'dus pas rdo rje'i tshig rnams gung bsgrigs te bris pa dge legs 'phel// maṅga laṃ//
